description: Returns the fields a template expects, read from its sample data: scalar fields by dotted path (e.g. customer.name) with type and sample value, and line_items (arrays of objects, e.g. invoice positions) with the fields of one item. Build the `data` object for create_pdf from this: nest dotted paths as objects (customer.name becomes { "customer": { "name": ... } }) and send line items as arrays of objects. Fields left out are rendered empty.

version.description: A template version; default the current one.

name: get_template_fields
title: Get the data fields of a template
